India Changes PUC Norms for BS-VI Vehicles, Offers Relief

The Indian government has revised rules for Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificates, providing relief to owners of BS-VI vehicles. These vehicles will now receive a three-year validity for their PUC certificates. For BS-IV and older vehicles, the PUC certificate will need to be renewed every six months. The changes aim to reduce the frequency of renewal for BS-VI vehicle owners.
